title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
hook_text: DistroKid is deleting tracks right now.
script:
DistroKid is quietly deleting music without any warning to artists.
Universal Music Group filed a lawsuit against the distributor in September.
The label claims DistroKid created a massive pipeline for computer generated tracks.
Musicians are taking to social media to complain about losing their work overnight.
DistroKid confirmed these sudden takedowns are a direct response to the legal claims.
Could your own catalog be next on the chopping block?
